motor-por-familia.d: Inference engine design in which each model family brings its own kernels, cache and draft verification (TensorFold), instead of fitting the model into the generic pieces of a platform (vLLM). It gains custom kernels and loses generality.

kernel-linha-independente.d: Kernel in which a row's arithmetic depends neither on the other rows in the call nor on how many there are: the split-K partition and the tiles are fixed by the weight shape. The same row has the same bits alone or in a batch.

massa-em-ponto-fixo.d: Probability converted to an integer, \(\lfloor e^{\tilde z_i - \tilde z_{\max}} \cdot 2^{40} \rfloor\), so that the cumulative top-p sums are exact in any order and identical on both ranks.

soma-em-ordem-de-rank.d: In TensorFold's tensor parallelism, each rank receives everyone's fp32 partials via all-gather and sums them itself, rank 0 first, rounding to bf16 only once, instead of using an all-reduce. With two ranks the order doesn't change any bits (the sum of two operands is commutative); the rule matters with 3 or more ranks and takes the order away from the communication library, so the transport no longer affects the bits.

lider-seguidor.t: SPMD with a leader (rank 0 decides, rank 1 applies)
lider-seguidor.d: Protocol in which rank 0 makes every decision that depends on time, clients or allocation and sends one message of operations per iteration (ADMIT, EVICT, MOVE, GROW, FILL, MFILL, ROUND, FINISH, IDLE; MFILL came with patch 0049 and is used with MULTI_PREFILL=1, the default; there is also SLOT, from 0035, only with TF_GLM_MULTI_LONE=1); rank 1 applies the same operations through the same code.

doorbell.d: A cheap signal by which one side tells the other that there is work. In TensorFold, the idle rank 1 waits on a TCPStore key instead of inside an all-gather, tying up neither the GPU nor the CPU; in the one-shot RDMA, the kernel rings a doorbell in pinned memory for the proxy thread.

reserva-de-memoria.d: Headroom that TensorFold's budget leaves free: budget = MemAvailable at startup − reserve. The default is max(4 GiB, RAM/10); the recipe uses 14.5 GiB (MEMORY_RESERVE_GIB). It covers the CUDA context, NCCL and the peak beyond the estimate.

extent.d: Contiguous range of rows \([\text{base}, \text{base}+\text{size})\) in a cache pool, with base and size multiples of 2,048 tokens in TensorFold. Each stream or kept prompt owns one; it grows in place, gets relocated or gets compacted.

all-gather-one-shot.d: A collective done in a single kernel call: the GPU writes the shard into pinned host memory, a proxy thread does an RDMA WRITE to the peer followed by a flag on the same QP, and the GPU waits for the flag and copies the shards in rank order. On GB10: 11 µs per 16 KiB versus 45 µs for NCCL.
